objective_value: <float> Total cost of the shipping plan, computed as transport costs plus demurrage costs plus procurement costs minus delivery revenues.

{vessel_id}.tail: <str> Origin node of the arc, formatted as a (port, time) pair for port-time nodes or (src/snk, vessel_id) for source/sink nodes.
{vessel_id}.head: <str> Destination node of the arc, formatted as a (port, time) pair for port-time nodes or (src/snk, vessel_id) for source/sink nodes.
{vessel_id}.type: <str> Arc category: 'travel' for transit between ports, 'demurrage' for waiting at a port, 'source' for departure from the virtual origin, or 'sink' for arrival at the virtual destination.
{vessel_id}.cost: <float> Cost incurred by traversing this arc, based on transport or demurrage rates.
{vessel_id}.product_flow: <float> Amount of cargo on board the vessel while traversing this arc.

port_inventories: <dict, key: '{port_id}'> Each value must contain exactly one inventory entry for every one-based time period 1..planning_horizon; period 0 must not be included.

{vessel_id}.port: <str> Identifier of the port where the operation takes place.
{vessel_id}.time: <int> Time period during which the operation occurs.
{vessel_id}.quantity: <float> Amount of product transferred: positive for loading at supply ports, negative for discharging at demand ports.
{vessel_id}.type: <str> Operation category: 'load' for picking up product at a supply port or 'discharge' for delivering product at a demand port.

cost_breakdown.transport_cost: <float> Total cost incurred across all vessels for traveling between ports.
cost_breakdown.demurrage_cost: <float> Total cost incurred across all vessels for waiting idle at ports.
cost_breakdown.procurement_cost: <float> Total cost paid for product loaded at all supply ports.
cost_breakdown.supply_revenue: <float> Total revenue earned from product delivered to all demand ports.
cost_breakdown.total_cost: <float> Net cost computed as transport cost plus demurrage cost plus procurement cost minus supply revenue.
